role.altitude: The floral designer keeps designing, building displays and teaching; only stem lists and workshop bookings change.
skills_to_grow: Keeping stem lists per design and workshop pages current
role.ambitious_version: A designer who runs more public workshops because bookings and payment take care of themselves.

tasks.short: Plan the display theme, order flowers and props, build and change in-store and window displays, photograph them and keep them fresh.

steps.what: Floral designer plans the theme and look of in-store and window displays for the season
Floral designer works out the stems and props needed and orders them from the wholesaler
Floral designer creates and changes the displays: arranges flowers, foliage, props and lighting
Floral designer photographs the finished display for the shop's records
Floral designer keeps the display fresh: water, replaces wilted flowers and tidies

tasks.design: Almost nothing changes: designing, building and caring for displays is hands-on work. The only change is a stem and props list per display design kept in the wholesaler's ordering portal ({PARTNER_PORTAL}), so a repeated or adapted display is reordered from the saved list instead of counted again.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nothing blocked it; the work is physical and visual.
tasks.enabler_now: Wholesaler portals keep saved order lists.
tasks.still_hard: Everything that makes a display good.
tasks.human_edge: An eye for colour, shape and what stops people at the window.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the designer's week.

reach.learn: Whether saved display lists are reused across seasons.

evidence.claim: Flower wholesalers' ordering portals let shops save and reuse order lists.
Display photos that show identifiable customers need their consent before use.

assumptions: Boundary: from the display plan to the display kept fresh; regular shop stock ordering is outside.
Input contract for s2: a saved stem and props list per display design kept by the designer in the portal; fallback is counting again.
About a third of displays repeat or adapt an earlier design; s2 is priced at that share.
Building and care keep their full time.
unknowns: How often displays change per year.

already_counted.description: Floral designer adapts a saved list to the new display before ordering.

incremental.description: Floral designer saves the stem list of each new display.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every display is new; high: seasonal displays repeated with small changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan the class or demonstration, take bookings, order materials per participant, prepare the workspace, and give the class or train other workers.

steps.what: Floral designer plans the class, demonstration or staff training: design, materials per person and handout
Customers book a place in a public workshop by phone or in the shop
Floral designer takes workshop bookings and payments and keeps the participant list
Floral designer works out and orders materials for the number of participants
Floral designer prepares the workspace and sets out materials
Floral designer conducts classes or demonstrations, or trains other workers

tasks.design: Public workshops get a booking page with payment in the shop's {ECOMMERCE} platform, so customers book and pay online and the participant list fills itself; the designer handles phone bookings and questions. Materials per participant are kept in the class plan, so the order is the per-person list times the bookings. Designing the class, preparing and teaching stay with the designer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bookings came by phone and in the shop and were kept on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Shop web platforms sell timed event tickets with payment.
tasks.human_edge: Showing a beginner how to make a bouquet that holds.

ambition.what: Regular public workshops that sell out online without the designer taking every booking.

tasks.altitude: Less phone admin; the designer's classes do not change.

reach.learn: Whether online booking fills workshops faster.

evidence.claim: Web shop platforms sell timed event tickets with payment and a participant list.
Workshop customers' contact details may be used for later offers only with consent or an opt-out offered each time.

assumptions: Boundary: from planning the class to the class given; selling products after the class is outside.
Input contract for s3: bookings with name, contact and payment from the booking page; phone bookings entered by the designer.
Coverage: about half of sessions are paid public workshops and about 70% of their bookings come online; s3 is priced at that share; staff training needs no bookings.
Customers' online booking takes about the time of a phone call; it is shown in s2 and outside the designer's savings.
Preparing and teaching keep their full time.
unknowns: Workshops per month and places per workshop.
research_questions: Do workshops fill faster with online booking?

already_counted.description: Floral designer enters phone bookings and answers questions about workshops.

incremental.description: Floral designer sets up the booking page for each workshop.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly staff training with no bookings; high: weekly public workshops with many online bookings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
